query:
SELECT DISTINCT l.message_id AS "message_id!"
            FROM voice_listens l
            INNER JOIN dm_messages d ON d.id = l.message_id
            WHERE l.message_id = ANY($1)
              AND (
                  l.user_id = $2
                  OR (d.sender_id = $2 AND l.user_id = d.recipient_id)
              )
